locations.name: Main Library
locations.accessNote: Entry requires scanning a valid University ID or library membership card at the security turnstiles.
locations.description: Primary library on City Campus housing quiet study areas, bookable group study rooms, presentation pods, open/closed booths, Create Space, SafePod research environment, and café/kitchenette amenities.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Verified: Level access at Smalls Wynd main entrance with automatic doors, two lifts serving multiple levels (east-end lift designated for fire evacuation), and accessible toilets on each floor. Full audit via AccessAble.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official Library hours on dundee.ac.uk/library/our-libraries.

studyFeatures.seatingSummary: Individual quiet desks, bookable group rooms, presentation pods & booths

locations.name: Tower Building
locations.accessNote: Main university entrance and reception desk; upper administrative and teaching offices may require staff/student card access.
locations.description: Opened in 1961, the Tower Building serves as the main entrance and administrative hub for the University of Dundee on Nethergate/Perth Road.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University of Dundee AccessAble & Locations directory for current lift and entrance guidance.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory for reception and desk hours.

locations.name: Dalhousie Building
locations.accessNote: Teaching building open to students with timetabled classes and authorised card access; individual lecture theatres and IT suites follow teaching schedules.
locations.description: Purpose-built central teaching facility on Old Hawkhill featuring tiered lecture theatres, seminar rooms, and IT suites accommodating up to 2,500 people.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University Locations and AccessAble listings for step-free access and hearing loop availability by room.
locations.openingHoursNote: Follows University teaching schedule; verify via official directory.

studyFeatures.seatingSummary: IT suites (when untimetabled) & public foyer tables

locations.name: DUSA – Dundee University Students' Association
locations.accessNote: Verified campus destination for students and visitors; evening union venues and society spaces follow DUSA entry policies.
locations.description: Central hub for student representation, societies, café/social dining, collaborative booths, and campus events at the heart of City Campus.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official DUSA and University AccessAble listings for specific floor and lift guidance.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official DUSA channels for daytime café and evening venue hours.

studyFeatures.seatingSummary: Informal collaborative social seating & student lounge booths

locations.name: Queen Mother Building
locations.accessNote: Primarily houses Computing; specialist computing laboratories require Computing student/staff card access.
locations.description: Situated on Balfour Street, the Queen Mother Building is the home of Computing at the University of Dundee, housing specialist computing labs and teaching rooms.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University Locations / AccessAble guide for lift and lab access details.
locations.openingHoursNote: Verify lab & building hours with School of Science and Engineering.

studyFeatures.seatingSummary: Computing labs (subject to School card access & timetabling)

locations.name: Fulton Building
locations.accessNote: Houses Mathematics, Physics, and Engineering teaching and laboratory facilities; specialist labs are restricted to enrolled students.
locations.description: Academic building supporting Mathematics, Physics, and Engineering disciplines on City Campus.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Refer to official University Locations & AccessAble directory.
locations.openingHoursNote: Verify access times with official University directory.

locations.name: Harris Building
locations.accessNote: Physics teaching and research spaces; laboratories require authorised access.
locations.description: City Campus building housing facilities and departments associated with Physics.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Refer to official University Locations & AccessAble directory.
locations.openingHoursNote: Verify access times with official University directory.

locations.name: Matthew Building
locations.accessNote: Houses Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art & Design (DJCAD); studio and workshop access is restricted to DJCAD students and staff, with public exhibition galleries.
locations.description: One of the two primary buildings housing Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art & Design (DJCAD), containing art studios, design workshops, and exhibition spaces.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Refer to official University Locations & AccessAble guide for DJCAD.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check DJCAD gallery & studio hours via official University pages.

locations.name: Crawford Building
locations.accessNote: Part of Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art & Design; studios and specialist workshops require DJCAD access.
locations.description: Companion structure to the Matthew Building housing Duncan of Jordanstone College of Art & Design (DJCAD) creative studios and teaching rooms.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Refer to official University Locations & AccessAble directory.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official DJCAD / University directory.

locations.name: Scrymgeour Building
locations.accessNote: Academic building accommodating Dundee Law School and seminar spaces.
locations.description: Located near Park Place, the Scrymgeour Building accommodates the Dundee Law School, lecture spaces, and academic offices.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Refer to official University Locations & AccessAble directory.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory.

locations.name: Old Medical School
locations.accessNote: Heritage teaching building supporting Education and Social Work.
locations.description: Historic City Campus building housing teaching and office spaces for Education and Social Work.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Heritage structure — check official AccessAble listing before visiting.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory.

locations.name: Old Technical Institute
locations.accessNote: University teaching and administrative heritage building.
locations.description: Part of the University of Dundee’s historic architectural core on City Campus near Smalls Wynd.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Heritage building — check official AccessAble listing.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory.

locations.name: Carnegie Building
locations.accessNote: Located inside Geddes Quadrangle; access depends on scheduled classes and offices.
locations.description: Built in 1909 as a physics laboratory within Geddes Quadrangle and historically associated with early X-ray crystallography work.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Historic 1909 building — verify step-free options on official AccessAble guide.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory.

locations.name: Carnelley Building
locations.accessNote: University science/academic building behind the Tower Building.
locations.description: Situated near College Green behind the Tower Building, historically connected with chemistry and science teaching at Dundee.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University AccessAble guide.
locations.openingHoursNote: Check official University directory.

locations.name: College Hall
locations.accessNote: University hall adjacent to College Green; open for scheduled events and exams.
locations.description: Located behind the Tower Building adjacent to College Green, used for academic functions, examinations, and campus events.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University AccessAble listing for event access.
locations.openingHoursNote: Event-based opening.

locations.name: Medical Sciences Institute
locations.accessNote: Life Sciences research and teaching hub; laboratories require strict authorised card access.
locations.description: Major hub for the School of Life Sciences on City Campus housing research laboratories and specialist academic units.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official University AccessAble listing.
locations.openingHoursNote: Authorised staff and Life Sciences student access only.

locations.name: Wellcome Trust Biocentre
locations.accessNote: Secure Life Sciences research facility; access is strictly restricted to authorised researchers and staff.
locations.description: Research centre adjacent to the Medical Sciences Institute and Sir James Black Centre dedicated to biological and biomedical research.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Restricted research building; contact building reception in advance.
locations.openingHoursNote: Restricted research access.

locations.name: Bonar Hall
locations.accessNote: Multi-purpose venue open during scheduled examinations, graduations, and conferences.
locations.description: Well-known University of Dundee multi-purpose venue on Park Place hosting examinations, graduations, concerts, and academic conferences.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Check official Bonar Hall / AccessAble guidance prior to events.
locations.openingHoursNote: Open for scheduled events and exams.

locations.name: Geddes Quadrangle
locations.accessNote: Open pedestrian campus quadrangle.
locations.description: Historic quadrangle named after Sir Patrick Geddes, first Professor of Botany at University College Dundee, who designed early teaching gardens here.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Outdoor paved and landscaped paths; gradients vary across historic stonework.
locations.openingHoursNote: Open pedestrian access.

locations.name: Campus Green
locations.accessNote: Open outdoor green space connecting City Campus academic buildings.
locations.description: Central lawn and outdoor social hub linking the Tower Building, Dalhousie Building, Main Library, and DUSA.
locations.accessibilityInfo: Paved perimeter paths link adjacent buildings.
locations.openingHoursNote: Open pedestrian access.

communityItems.title: Welcome to CampusPulse Dundee (CS32005 Independent Student Project)
communityItems.body: Use Smart Study Space Finder and voluntary QR check-ins to share study room availability across City Campus. All occupancy figures are community-reported estimates, not official University data.

communityItems.title: Tip: Quiet Level 2 booths at Main Library before 10:00 (Demo)
communityItems.body: Early morning arrival gives the best choice of window desks with sockets. Remember your University ID card for the Smalls Wynd turnstiles.
